aboutHeading: Four decades of keeping neighbors comfortable
aboutParagraphs: Terrell Heating & A/C has been family owned and operated since 1984. For more than 40 years we've installed and serviced heating and cooling systems for families in Bloomington and the surrounding area.
We specialize in the installation and service of Ducane and Tempstar heating and cooling units, and we hold an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.
